messages:
maria_cs: Quick heads-up — onboarding with Finch Labs hitting lots of 429s from the browser SDK after they ramp to ~150 concurrent users. They say errors start ~30s after starting tests. Logs show `status: 429` + `x-ratelimit-remaining: 0`.

sam_eng: :eyes: do we have their app id? sample logs?

maria_cs: sending snippets — they use the browser SDK with a shared publishable key, high fanout on page load. Config:
```
const client = new RedwoodClient({ key: 'pk_live_abc123', prefetch: true, concurrency: 10 });
client.generate(...)
```
They also preflight a bunch of endpoints on init.

lucas_se: if it's a publishable key, it's subject to per-key fanout limits. Browser -> many short-lived connections -> hits rate limiter quickly. Are they reusing same key across tabs/sessions?

maria_cs: yes, they used the same key across tabs and workers. They wanted quick integration without a proxy. :grimacing:

sam_eng: two quick fixes: 1) advise using server-side token relay (issue ephemeral session token per user) 2) reduce client concurrency and debounce preflight calls. Also we can temporarily raise their account rate window while they ramp — need eng approval.

deploy-bot: Incident auto-flag: customer_finchlabs ramping causing quota_exhaustion for browser keys. Ticket created: #INC-4621

lucas_se: I'll coordinate with infra to check spike protection rules for publishable keys. We can add a doc snippet showing how to mint ephemeral tokens from server:
```
POST /session-token
Authorization: Bearer sk_xxx
=> { client_token: 'temp_eyJ...' , expires_in: 300 }
```
Client uses that for short-lived sessions.

maria_cs: shared next steps for the customer call at 10am PT: (1) switch to ephemeral tokens, (2) throttle preflight, (3) run ramp with our suggested profile. I'll send a calendar invite.

sam_eng: Also add a note in onboarding checklist: 'Do not expose SK or reuse PK across heavy fanout; use ephemeral tokens or seat tokens' — I can PR docs.

maria_cs: Great. For immediate mitigation, can eng temporarily bump their window? We need a fast unblock — they're in POC.

lucas_se: I can approve a short-term bump for 1 hour (non-prod buffer) and add logging to catch recurrence. I'll mark as done in the ticket.

maria_cs: Thanks. Marking this thread resolved after the 10am call. I'll capture feedback for renewals (POC success ties to better onboarding docs). :thumbsup:

sam_eng: :+1: follow-up: create a small example repo for ephemeral token server and link in docs.

maria_cs: Assigned tasks: docs PR (sam), infra bump & monitoring (lucas), onboarding call (maria). Will update ticket #INC-4621 after call.

maria_cs: resolved
